class.name: OcgXcafdocNotestool
class.brief_description: A tool to annotate items in the hierarchical product structure. There are two basic entities, which operates the notes tool: notes and annotated items. A note is a user defined data structure derived from XCAFDoc_Note attribute that is attached to a separate label under the notes hive. An annotated item is represented by XCAFDoc_AssemblyItemRef attribute attached to a separate label under the annotated items hive. Notes are linked with annotated items by means of XCAFDoc_GraphNode attribute. Notes play parent roles and annotated items - child roles.
class.description: ! A tool to annotate items in the hierarchical product structure. ! There are two basic entities, which operates the notes tool: notes ! and annotated items. A note is a user defined data structure derived ! from \ref XCAFDoc_Note attribute that is attached to a separate label under ! the notes hive. An annotated item is represented by \ref XCAFDoc_AssemblyItemRef ! attribute attached to a separate label under the annotated items ! hive. Notes are linked with annotated items by means of \ref XCAFDoc_GraphNode ! attribute. Notes play parent roles and annotated items - child roles. ! ! ------------------------ ! | XCAFDoc_DocumentTool | ! | 0:1 | ! ------------------------ ! |1 ! ------------------------ ! | XCAFDoc_NotesTool | ! | 0:1:9 | ! ------------------------ ! |1 ! | ------------------- --------------------------- ! +___| Notes |-----| XCAFDoc_Note | ! | 1| 0:1:9:1 |1 *| 0:1:9:1:* | ! | ------------------- --------------------------- ! | !* ! | { XCAFDoc_GraphNode } ! | *! ! | ------------------- --------------------------- ! +___| Annotated items |-----| XCAFDoc_AssemblyItemRef | ! 1| 0:1:9:2 |1 *| 0:1:9:2:* | ! ------------------- --------------------------- ! ! A typical annotation procedure is illustrated by the code example below: ! \code{.c++} ! // Get the notes tool from a XCAF document ! occ::handle<XCAFDoc_NotesTool> aNotesTool = XCAFDoc_DocumentTool::NotesTool(aDoc->Main()); ! // Create new comment note ! occ::handle<XCAFDoc_Note> aNote = aNotesTool->CreateComment(aUserName, aTimestamp, aComment); ! if (!aNote.IsNull()) { ! occ::handle<XCAFDoc_AssemblyItemRef> aRef = aNotesTool->AddNote(aNote->Label(), ! anAssemblyItemId); if (aRef.IsNull()) { ! // Process error... ! } ! } ! \endcode

method.name: default
method.description: Creates an empty notes tool.

method.name: GetNotesLabel
method.description: Returns the label of the notes hive.

method.name: GetAnnotatedItemsLabel
method.description: Returns the label of the annotated items hive.

method.name: NbNotes
method.description: Returns the number of labels in the notes hive.

method.name: NbAnnotatedItems
method.description: Returns the number of labels in the annotated items hive.

method.name: IsAnnotatedItem_1
method.description: Checks if the given assembly item is annotated.

method.name: IsAnnotatedItem_2
method.description: Checks if the given labeled item is annotated.

method.name: FindAnnotatedItem_1
method.description: Finds a label of the given assembly item ID in the annotated items hive.

method.name: FindAnnotatedItem_2
method.description: Finds a label of the given labeled item in the annotated items hive.

method.name: FindAnnotatedItemAttr_1
method.description: Finds a label of the given assembly item's attribute in the annotated items hive.

method.name: FindAnnotatedItemAttr_2
method.description: Finds a label of the given labeled item's attribute in the annotated items hive.

method.name: FindAnnotatedItemSubshape_1
method.description: Finds a label of the given assembly item's subshape in the annotated items hive.

method.name: FindAnnotatedItemSubshape_2
method.description: Finds a label of the given labeled item's subshape in the annotated items hive.

method.name: RemoveNote_1
method.description: Removes the given note from the assembly item.

method.name: RemoveNote_2
method.description: Removes the given note from the labeled item.

method.name: RemoveSubshapeNote_1
method.description: Removes the given note from the assembly item's subshape.

method.name: RemoveSubshapeNote_2
method.description: Removes the given note from the labeled item's subshape.

method.name: RemoveAttrNote_1
method.description: Removes a note from the assembly item's attribute.

method.name: RemoveAttrNote_2
method.description: Removes a note from the labeled item's attribute.

method.name: RemoveAllNotes_1
method.description: Removes all notes from the assembly item.

method.name: RemoveAllNotes_2
method.description: Removes all notes from the labeled item.

method.name: RemoveAllSubshapeNotes
method.description: Removes all notes from the assembly item's subshape.

method.name: RemoveAllAttrNotes_1
method.description: Removes all notes from the assembly item's attribute.

method.name: RemoveAllAttrNotes_2
method.description: Removes all notes from the labeled item's attribute.

method.name: DeleteNote
method.description: Deletes the given note. Removes all links with items annotated by the note.

method.name: DeleteAllNotes
method.description: Deletes all notes. Clears all annotations.

method.name: NbOrphanNotes
method.description: Returns number of notes that aren't linked to annotated items.

method.name: DeleteOrphanNotes
method.description: Deletes all notes that aren't linked to annotated items.

method.name: GetID
method.description: Returns default attribute GUID
